decisions.decision: Supabase auth replaces Laravel JWT auth on frontend; backend verifies Supabase tokens
decisions.rationale: User chose 'bypass Laravel auth entirely' — Supabase handles login/register, access token sent to Laravel API

decisions.decision: VITE_ prefix required for env vars (not NEXT_PUBLIC_)
decisions.rationale: Vite project, not Next.js. NEXT_PUBLIC_ is Next.js-only.

decisions.decision: Supabase URL = base URL only (no /rest/v1/ suffix)
decisions.rationale: Supabase JS SDK appends paths internally

decisions.decision: SupabaseAuthMiddleware auto-provisions local user + seeds categories on first Supabase login
decisions.rationale: Laravel data layer uses integer user IDs; Supabase auth uses UUIDs — local row bridges the gap without a separate onboarding step
